name: @avs/pc-optimizer
description: AVS AI Shield: Security & System Intelligence — Windows performance, cleanup, and security utility.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && cd electron && tsc
scripts.package: yarn download-clamav && cross-env AVS_ENV=production yarn build && yarn build:backend && cross-env AVS_ENV=production electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:installer: yarn download-clamav && cross-env AVS_ENV=production yarn build && yarn build:backend && cross-env AVS_ENV=production electron-builder --win --x64 --config.nsis.oneClick=false
scripts.package:portable: yarn download-clamav && cross-env AVS_ENV=production yarn build && yarn build:backend && cross-env AVS_ENV=production electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.package:all: yarn download-clamav && cross-env AVS_ENV=production yarn build && yarn build:backend && cross-env AVS_ENV=production electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:dir: yarn download-clamav && cross-env AVS_ENV=production yarn build && yarn build:backend && cross-env AVS_ENV=production electron-builder --dir

_comment_build_config: Packaging config lives ONLY in electron-builder.yml — do not add a 'build' field here, it can silently shadow or conflict with the yml config.
